name_input: M/s OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED; OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED (SERVICE CENTRE); Oswal Pumps Ltd.; OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED; OSWAL PUMPS LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/oswal-pumps-limited) — exact row: "2026-02-26 | OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED | TO THE ORDER OF SHIPPER | S/STEEL FABRICATED SUBMERSIBLE WATER PUMPS DETAIL AS PER INVOICE ATTD.INVOICE.ITEM SR.NO.7 QTY 20 NOS- | SONEPAT ICD INBDM6, India | Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | 84137010 | 1049281". Second export row: "2026-02-07 | OSWAL PUMPS LIMITED | TO THE ORDER | SPARE PARTS - DETAIL AS PER INVOICE ATT.ITEM SR.NO- 20- | SONEPAT ICD INBDM6, India | Casablanca, MOROCCO | 84139120 | 9474003". Page header states "Total Shipments 3031 Records detected", "Trading Partners 13", "Ports 33", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-26". Top destination ports listed: SONEPAT ICD 235, MISURATA 94, SONEPAT ICD INBDM6 83, Misurata 53, Jebel Ali 46. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 3031 total shipments; I actually saw 5 individual dated rows (3 export, 2 import) in the free view — the 3031 figure is the site's own counter and is NOT independently verified.
domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.oswalpumps.com/) states: "1,406 Dealers & 220 service centres in 16 states" and "trusted under PM-KUSUM across India" — this is a self-declaration, not a shipment/contract record. Investor-relations page (https://www.oswalpumps.com/investor-relations/) confirms the company is "NSE · BSE listed" and publishes "Q2 FY2026-27 Financial Results (Consolidated, Unaudited) · 12 Nov 2026", i.e. audited/unaudited financial statements with revenue splits exist as public filings, but the actual revenue figures and domestic-vs-export split were not readable in the free view (PDF links only, no numbers extracted). No GeM/CPPP tender award or GST turnover band was retrievable — web_search tool was down (searx connection refused) for all queries, so no tender portal could be reached. GSTIN and revenue figures: null (not public in sources read).
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: 26.02.2026 Sonepat ICD → Jebel Ali (UAE), HS 84137010, B/L 1049281; 07.02.2026 Sonepat ICD → Casablanca (Morocco), HS 84139120, B/L 9474003. Declared HS 841381 differs from the HS codes actually used in shipments (84137010 for submersible water pumps, 84139120 for pump parts) — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the factual HS should be corrected to 84137010 (pumps) / 84139120 (parts), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer (own plant at Oswal Estate, NH-1, Kutail Road, Karnal, Haryana; ISO 9001:2015, ISI/BEE marked, NSE/BSE listed) — not a trader. Industry claim "Металлургия и горнодобыча" (metallurgy/mining) is inaccurate: the company makes solar, submersible and monoblock pumps and motors; pumps are used in mining dewatering but the company itself is a pump manufacturer. Domestic supply: only declared (dealer network, PM-KUSUM participation, listed-company financials), no individual domestic contract or GST turnover figure was verifiable in this session — recorded as declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null — no figures were readable; not invented. Caveat on data quality: the ImportKey free view also shows import rows (magnets from Hunan Strong Magnets, stamping press from Zhejiang Etone, connectors from Yueqing Xianglang), consistent with a manufacturer importing components; the "3031 shipments" counter mixes imports and exports and was not independently verified.
